title: Horse with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='eyeGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#aaddff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3388cc'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sparkle' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffffaa'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd44'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='68' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#c87137'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='64' rx='20' ry='11' fill='#e09050'/>

  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a85a28'/>
  <rect x='66' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a85a28'/>
  <!-- hooves back -->
  <rect x='30' y='91' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='91' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a3a1a'/>

  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#b8642e'/>
  <rect x='58' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#b8642e'/>
  <!-- hooves front -->
  <rect x='38' y='91' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6b451f'/>
  <rect x='58' y='91' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6b451f'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <polygon points='68,58 78,42 88,48 80,66' fill='#c87137'/>
  <polygon points='70,58 78,46 85,50 79,64' fill='#d88848'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='38' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#c87137'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='35' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e09050'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='94' cy='42' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#f0b080'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <ellipse cx='96' cy='41' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#a04a20'/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <polygon points='74,30 71,20 78,26' fill='#b8642e'/>
  <polygon points='74.5,28 72.5,22 77,26' fill='#f0a070'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='33' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#1a1a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='33' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <!-- sparkle 1 -->
  <circle cx='83.5' cy='31' r='1.8' fill='url(#sparkle)'/>
  <!-- sparkle 2 -->
  <circle cx='80.5' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle 3 -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='35.5' r='0.8' fill='#ccddff'/>

  <!-- eyelashes -->
  <line x1='77.5' y1='29' x2='75.5' y2='26' stroke='#3a2a5a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='79.5' y1='28' x2='78.5' y2='25' stroke='#3a2a5a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='81.5' y1='27.8' x2='81.5' y2='24.5' stroke='#3a2a5a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M74,28 Q70,22 72,18 Q76,24 78,28' fill='#5a2a10'/>
  <path d='M76,32 Q72,26 74,22 Q78,28 80,32' fill='#6a3a18'/>
  <path d='M78,38 Q74,32 76,28 Q80,34 82,38' fill='#5a2a10'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M26,62 Q18,55 16,48 Q20,52 24,56' fill='#5a2a10' stroke='none'/>
  <path d='M26,64 Q16,60 14,52 Q18,56 23,60' fill='#6a3a18' stroke='none'/>
  <path d='M27,66 Q19,66 16,60 Q20,62 24,64' fill='#5a2a10' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M92,46 Q94,48 96,46' fill='none' stroke='#a04a20' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
